acceptance_convention.note: the 0.05 validation gate binds at a future validation-once stage requiring its own sealed-split authorization; no v16 stage in this preregistration opens validation or test_id

authorization.delegation_source: lead standing directive 2026-08-26 '请自行推进' plus this explicit conditional long-training authorization
authorization.interpretation: freeze this preregistration, run smoke; if and only if each stage's frozen gates pass, proceed pilot then long without further per-stage confirmation
authorization.lead_directive_verbatim: 继续，符合条件启动长训

known_risks_disclosed: uniform family f=0.44 in r4e12 (its oracle bound 0.124 is the smallest; rank-16 ceiling is a separate line)
marmousi parent rel_l2 0.60 is a basis ceiling the head cannot fix
probe convergence horizon was measured on 3 records; the multi-record horizon may differ; patience and honest budget_limit reporting cover this
claim_boundary.long: train-split generalization at scale; the 0.05 acceptance claim requires a future sealed validation-once stage not covered here
claim_boundary.pilot: first held-out-train generalization evidence; not validation evidence

evidence_chain.finding: 1202-parameter head is the binding constraint; direct-fit arm reaches 80-99% of the per-record oracle (iii) bound

29 deployment channels carry sufficient information (best fit_rel_err 0.346); regression supervision does not rescue the small head; a_clip regression is systematically harmful on uniform (9.8% pixel saturation)
D1: width-128 M2 head (25266 params, field loss, lr 3e-3 constant) reaches f = 0.436/0.682/0.812; W+ width margin holds; cosine schedule and hybrid supervision add nothing decisive

design_basis.prior_setting_disclosure: all v16 smoke thresholds below are priors set in this NEW preregistration, informed by the r4e10-r4e12 train-only probes and disclosed as such; no frozen v15 gate is moved (veto a compliance); the v15 candidate keeps its recorded failed_gate; v16 is a new candidate with fresh accounting. correction of record: the 2026-08-26 draft suggested smoke loss gate 0.30, which contradicts the r4e12 W-arm measured per-record loss reductions {uniform 0.143, layered 0.533, marmousi 0.232}; the frozen value is 0.10, set BEFORE the v16 smoke run from probe data only

inherited_vetoes: a: no frozen threshold is moved toward a measured value of its own gated run
b: the correction mask derives from parent frame energy only, never deployment-time truth
c: no transplanted or synthetic-panel oracle constant is an acceptance baseline; oracle bounds are recomputed on the scored record
d: the smoke loss gate is a wiring check, never learning or convergence evidence
e: the correction is an output-field data fit plus a feature-driven ansatz, not a physics or PDE residual, and no PDE residual is evaluated anywhere
f: smoke evidence itself never promotes; promotion flows from the lead conditional authorization recorded above
promotion_rule: smoke gates all pass -> pilot; pilot gates all pass -> long; any gate failure stops the chain with an honest fail_gate terminal and no further stage; veto (f) is respected because promotion authority is this lead conditional directive, not the smoke evidence itself

records_and_roles.first_generalization_evidence: pilot_confirm; smoke is wiring plus capacity re-confirmation on 3 records and is NOT generalization evidence
records_and_roles.smoke: role smoke, 3 records (same three ruled records as v15)
records_and_roles.truth_access: train split only, per-stage allowlist drawn from panels roles; any non-train or off-list sample id is a refusal; validation and test_id stay sealed and are never opened by any v16 stage

long.budget_note: wall and gpu-second values inherited unchanged from the frozen v12 budget chain
long.epoch_definition: one epoch = 8 seeded shuffled passes over long_fit = 1536 updates; disclosed derivation: r4e12 horizon showed >= 3072 updates needed on 3 records; per-record exposure scaled for 192-record diversity within the inherited wall budget

per_family_improvement.rule: per-family mean gain_iii >= 0.005 for all 3 families
per-family mean gain_iii over pilot_confirm >= 0.005 for all 3 families

loss_per_record.rule: per-record loss reduction 1 - final/initial >= 0.10 on 3/3 records
loss_per_record.source: r4e12 W measured {0.143,0.533,0.232}, floor with margin

nonworse.source: r4e12 W improved all three; tightened from v15's 2/3

oracle_gain.rule: achieved gain (iii) >= 0.35 x per-record recomputed oracle bound on >= 2/3 records

smoke.sampling: round-robin over the 3 smoke records (matches r4e12 W arm exactly)

structure.head: M2 topology width 128, verbatim r4e12 W arm: depthwise-separable Conv2d 29->29(dw3x3)->128(pw1x1)->SiLU->128(dw3x3)->128(pw1x1)->SiLU->128(dw3x3)->16(pw1x1), zero-init last layer, tanh output
structure.output_contract: tanh times frozen per-family coefficient scale; rank-16 temporal basis coefficient maps; confined correction path; parent-energy keep mask tau=0.001; 29 frozen deployment-causal channels; basis_rank16 and TAU unchanged

training.divergence_sentinel: if the stage monitor loss is non-finite, stage fails immediately; calibration-based patience handles slow divergence
training.objective: masked_confined_loss (field), single objective, no auxiliary terms
